meaning:
κορβάν (Rec., T, -βᾶν), indecl. (Heb. קׇרְבָּן),

elsewhere.note: The chief priests took the pieces of silver, and said, “It’s not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood.”
But you say, ‘If a man tells his father or his mother, “Whatever profit you might have received from me is Corban,” ’ ” that is to say, given to God,
